events.title: 72 Seconds — Live Gameplay
events.summary: Watch 72 Seconds in action! Command squads, research upgrades, build your forces, and fight off alien swarms in this sci-fi real-time strategy game.The demo is live for Steam Next Fest. Stop by, watch some gameplay, and check out the demo!
